versions.changelog: The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

xiaohongshu-wealth-faq-talking 0.1.1

- Initial release for turning Xiaohongshu wealth FAQ notes into short, separate talking FAQ clips (2–15s each).
- Reads public note questions and speaks only already-written product answers.
- Strict guardrails: no invented returns, no personalized advice, no stitching of clips.
- Carefully stages each step (note lookup, voice clone, speech, video) with visible, explicit approval and live price checks.
- Full inspection and reporting of each input asset; supports only advisor-authorized use of likeness or voice.
- Routes related material requests to designated adjacent skill endpoints for clarity and security.
